UK PM Andy Burnham to hold 'serious dialogue' with EU

UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham has stated that the current relationship with Brussels is "not good enough" and has promised "serious dialogue" regarding the UK's future place in Europe. He described an upcoming summit next month as a "reset" and the first step towards closer ties, though acknowledged potential trade tensions could be problematic. Details of Burnham's meetings with Manchester City have also been released.
